purpose: Controlled diagnostic; not production memory-transfer acceptance.
production_bit_source: fc5b8bb, with the same-route DRIVE16 override recorded in ../20261029_swd_main_drive_ab/manifest.json
observed: On the SAME GPIO ODDR bit/ELF pair, direct -> short -> direct reproduces FAIL -> PASS -> FAIL at nominal 10k/100k/1MHz. Short passes at actual FCLK 99,999,999Hz (5ns requested high) and 49,999,999.5Hz (10ns requested high). ACK, DPIDR and parity all pass in every short case. Production PL with a minimal no-USB/no-DAP driver still fails at FCLK50MHz.
limits: High pulse duration is the digital ODDR request, not an analog measurement at the MCU pin. Nominal GPIO bit rate excludes software/MMIO overhead.

Pad counter matches the 200 intended rising edges. The level-comparison sticky bits can fire in valid 5ns pulses because pad propagation outlasts the requested high; they do not by themselves prove an extra edge.
Only DPIDR is checked by the fixture. A production fix must still pass AP/block memory transfers at all required frequencies.
